# Octofit-tracker Fitness App React Cosmetics Guidelines

Every cosmetic change to the React frontend should follow these guidelines:

* The Navbar should include the OctoFit logo and the app name "OctoFit Tracker". The logo should be placed to the left of the app name.
* The color scheme should be consistent with the OctoFit brand colors: .
a green gradient background: linear-gradient(90deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%);
primary color: #43e97b;
secondary color: #38f9d7;
accent color: #21c08b;
text color: #222;
background color: #f6fff9;
* The banner should occupy the full width of the page and have a height of 500px. 
* The lettering should be bold and use a modern sans-serif font. The text should be centered both vertically and horizontally within the banner.
